items.title: TSMC expected to announce $100B investment in U.S.
items.title_zh: 台积电预计宣布在美国投资 1000 亿美元
items.summary: TSMC is expected to announce a $100 billion investment in the United States.

items.title: Mistral OCR
items.raw_content: The most powerful AI platform for enterprises. Customize, fine-tune, and deploy AI assistants, autonomous agents, and multimodal AI with open models.
items.title_zh: Mistral OCR
items.summary: Mistral has published a news page for Mistral OCR as part of its enterprise AI platform, which the company describes as supporting customized assistants, autonomous agents and multimodal AI built on open models.

items.title: ByteDance launches new round of stock buybacks, raising its valuation to $315 billion
items.raw_content: ByteDance, the parent company of TikTok, has launched a new stock buyback program offering US employees $189.90 per share, Reuters reported
items.title_zh: 字节跳动启动新一轮股票回购，估值升至 3150 亿美元
items.summary: ByteDance has launched a new stock buyback program offering US employees $189.90 per share, Reuters reported; the round lifts the company's valuation to $315 billion.

items.title: Moscow-based global news network has infected Western AI tools
items.title_zh: 莫斯科背景的全球新闻网络已渗透西方 AI 工具
items.summary: A NewsGuard Reality Check report alleges that a Moscow-based global news network has infected Western AI tools.

items.title: Tesla Sales Fall Off a Cliff Globally, Including Germany, Australia, and China
items.raw_content: German sales were down by a massive 76.3% last month, with Australia posting a similar 71.9% decline
items.title_zh: 特斯拉全球销量断崖式下滑，德国、澳大利亚和中国均受影响
items.summary: Tesla sales fell sharply around the world last month, with Germany down 76.3% and Australia down 71.9%, according to Carscoops.

items.summary: TSMC is expected to announce a $100 billion investment in the United States.

items.title: Tesla Sales Fall Off a Cliff Globally, Including Germany, Australia, and China
items.title_zh: 特斯拉全球销量断崖式下滑，德国、澳大利亚和中国均受影响
items.summary: Tesla sales fell sharply around the world last month, with Germany down 76.3% and Australia down 71.9%, according to Carscoops.

items.title: About Google Chrome's "This extension may soon no longer be supported" (2024)
items.title_zh: 关于 Google Chrome“此扩展程序可能很快将不再受支持”（2024）
items.summary: A uBlock Origin wiki page explains Google Chrome's warning that the extension may soon no longer be supported.

items.title: The Golden Age of Japanese Pencils (2022)
items.title_zh: 日本铅笔的黄金时代（2022）
items.summary: A historical article recounts how Tombow Pencil executives set out to revolutionize the Japanese pencil industry in the summer of 1952.

items.title: Public health data disappeared. RestoredCDC.org is bringing it back
items.title_zh: 公共卫生数据消失，RestoredCDC.org 正在将其恢复
items.summary: The RestoredCDC.org project is working to bring back public health data that has disappeared from official sources.

items.title: Apple unveils new Mac Studio
items.title_zh: 苹果发布新款 Mac Studio
items.summary: Apple announced the new Mac Studio, which it calls its most powerful Mac, pairing the M4 Max with the newly introduced M3 Ultra chip.

items.title: Things we've learned about building products
items.title_zh: 我们在打造产品中学到的 50 件事
items.summary: To mark 50,000 subscribers to its Product for Engineers newsletter, PostHog published 50 lessons it says it has learned about building great products.

items.title: Exploring Polymorphism in C: Lessons from Linux and FFmpeg's Code Design (2019)
items.title_zh: 在 C 语言中探索多态：来自 Linux 与 FFmpeg 代码设计的经验（2019）
items.summary: A 2019 article explains how parts of the Linux and FFmpeg C codebases are structured for extensibility, effectively achieving polymorphism-like behavior.

items.title: AI tools are spotting errors in research papers
items.title_zh: AI 工具正在发现研究论文中的错误
items.summary: Large language models are increasingly used to check research papers for errors, but researchers warn that the tools come with risks, Nature reports.

items.title: Falkon: A KDE Web Browser
items.title_zh: Falkon：一款 KDE 网页浏览器
items.summary: Falkon is an open-source web browser from KDE that focuses on privacy, security and customization.

items.title: The program is the database is the interface
items.title_zh: 程序就是数据库，数据库就是界面
items.summary: A blog post describes the author's yearly accounting script and the workflow around it, using the example to explore the relationship between programs, databases and interfaces.

items.title: It is as if you were on your phone
items.title_zh: 《就像你在看手机》：一款假装玩手机的游戏
items.summary: Pippin Barr's game asks players to pretend to be on their phone, passing as human while doing essentially nothing, as a comment on the pressure to be constantly on screens.

items.title: With AI you need to think bigger
items.title_zh: 有了 AI，你需要把格局放大
items.summary: The author describes how AI has removed his fear of tackling large or unfamiliar projects, recalling a past multi-layer PCB and FPGA job that once seemed too risky to attempt.

items.title: MS Paint IDE
items.title_zh: MS Paint IDE
items.summary: The site invites developers to ditch IDEs like IntelliJ and Eclipse in favor of MS Paint, which it calls a real IDE.

items.title: ByteDance launches new round of stock buybacks, raising its valuation to $315 billion
items.title_zh: 字节跳动启动新一轮股票回购，估值升至 3150 亿美元
items.summary: ByteDance has launched a new stock buyback program offering US employees $189.90 per share, Reuters reported; the round lifts the company's valuation to $315 billion.

items.title: Chinese AI startup Zhipu secures over $140 million in new strategic funding
items.title_zh: 中国 AI 初创公司智谱获逾 1.4 亿美元新战略融资
items.summary: Chinese AI startup Zhipu announced it raised over RMB 1 billion ($140 million) in a new strategic funding round, with Hangzhou among the investors.

items.title: Former Intel directors oppose TSMC’s takeover of Intel’s foundry
items.title_zh: 前 Intel 董事反对台积电收购 Intel 晶圆代工业务
items.summary: Four former Intel directors wrote in Fortune criticizing a TSMC takeover of Intel's foundry business and suggesting that Intel should spin off instead.

items.title: ByteDance launches Trae AI IDE in China with Doubao-1.5-Pro and DeepSeek Models
items.title_zh: 字节跳动在中国推出 Trae AI IDE，集成 Doubao-1.5-Pro 与 DeepSeek 模型
items.summary: ByteDance launched the Chinese edition of Trae on March 3; the AI-native IDE is described as China's first and comes with Doubao-1.5-Pro and DeepSeek models.

items.title: Luchen Technology becomes first to drop DeepSeek API over cost concerns
items.title_zh: Luchen Technology 因成本顾虑率先停用 DeepSeek API
items.summary: Luchen Technology, an AI infrastructure company, says it has stopped using DeepSeek's API, making it the first company to formally do so, with cost given as the reason.

items.title: Tencent’s Yuanbao tops Apple’s China App Store, surpassing DeepSeek
items.title_zh: 腾讯元宝登顶苹果中国 App Store 免费榜，超越 DeepSeek
items.summary: As of March 3, Tencent's Yuanbao AI chatbot held the No. 1 spot among free downloads in Apple's China App Store, ahead of DeepSeek.

items.title: Chinese AI startup Baichuan shifts focus to core business, shuts B2B financial services unit
items.title_zh: 百川智能收缩业务，关停 B2B 金融服务部门
items.summary: Chinese AI startup Baichuan has restructured its operations and shut its B2B financial services unit, saying it will focus on core business areas, according to TechNode.

items.title: Meituan’s next decade: expands global footprint with focus on retail and AI
items.title_zh: 美团的未来十年：聚焦零售与 AI，加速海外扩张
items.summary: Meituan is accelerating global expansion with a renewed focus on grocery retail and international markets, according to TechNode.

items.title: China’s Geely steps up restructuring with new intelligent driving brand
items.title_zh: 吉利推进重组，推出智能驾驶新品牌
items.summary: Geely Auto has launched a dedicated intelligent-driving brand and plans to equip every future model with an advanced driver assistance system.

items.title: J&T Express reports 15.9% revenue growth in 2024, turns profit
items.title_zh: J&T Express 2024 年营收增长 15.9%，实现盈利
items.summary: J&T Express said 2024 revenue rose 15.9% from a year earlier to $10.26 billion, while parcel volume climbed 31% to 24.65 billion; the company also reported a profit.

items.title: Agent-RL/ReCall
items.title_zh: Agent-RL/ReCall：让 LLM 通过强化学习学会搜索与工具调用
items.summary: A Python repository gathering ReSearch and ReCall, which use reinforcement learning to teach LLMs to reason with search and tool calls.

items.title: elder-plinius/CL4R1T4S
items.title_zh: elder-plinius/CL4R1T4S：各大 AI 系统泄露系统提示词合集
items.summary: CL4R1T4S collects what it describes as leaked system prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, Cursor, Lovable, Replit and other AI systems.

items.title: dontriskit/awesome-ai-system-prompts
items.title_zh: dontriskit/awesome-ai-system-prompts：精选 AI 系统提示词
items.summary: A curated TypeScript collection of system prompts from tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Manus and Windsurf, aimed at AI agent builders and prompt engineers.

items.title: Xiaojiu-z/EasyControl
items.title_zh: Xiaojiu-z/EasyControl：为扩散 Transformer 提供灵活控制
items.summary: A Python implementation of EasyControl, a method for adding efficient and flexible control to diffusion transformers, tied to an ICCV 2025 paper.

items.title: ahujasid/mcp-for-blender
items.title_zh: ahujasid/mcp-for-blender：用 LLM 控制 Blender 的社区插件
items.summary: A community plugin that lets users control Blender 3D with an LLM of their choice; it is not affiliated with the official Blender Foundation.

items.title: Taxuspt/garmin_mcp
items.title_zh: garmin_mcp：访问 Garmin 数据的 MCP 服务器
items.summary: A Python MCP server that provides access to Garmin data.

items.title: KalyanKS-NLP/llm-engineer-toolkit
items.title_zh: llm-engineer-toolkit：120 多个 LLM 库的分类清单
items.summary: A curated list of more than 120 LLM libraries, organized by category for engineers.

items.title: z-libraryopp/z-libraryopp.github.io
items.title_zh: Z-Library 镜像与入口导航页
items.summary: A GitHub Pages repository that lists Z-Library mirror addresses and entry points for accessing the service.

items.title: smtg-ai/claude-squad
items.title_zh: claude-squad：统一管理多个终端 AI 智能体
items.summary: A Go tool for managing multiple AI terminal agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Amp.

items.title: A2Perf: Real-World Autonomous Agents Benchmark
items.title_zh: A2Perf：真实世界自主智能体基准测试
items.summary: A2Perf is an open-source benchmark from Apple with three environments — computer chip floorplanning, web navigation and quadruped locomotion — measuring task performance, generalization, resource efficiency and reliability for autonomous agents.

items.title: Performance Comparison of Large Language Models on Advanced Calculus Problems
items.title_zh: 大语言模型在高等微积分问题上的性能比较
items.summary: The study evaluated seven LLMs, including ChatGPT 4o, Gemini Advanced, Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Mistral AI, on 32 advanced calculus problems worth 320 points, finding varied strengths and weaknesses and noting that re-prompting sometimes corrected wrong answers.

items.title: Trim My View: An LLM-Based Code Query System for Module Retrieval in Robotic Firmware
items.title_zh: Trim My View：面向机器人固件模块检索的 LLM 代码查询系统
items.summary: The paper combines binary decomposition, decompilation passes and LLM-powered function summarization to identify modules in stripped robotic firmware; with CodeStral as the backend it reached an average F1 score of 0.68 across 467 ArduPilot modules.

items.title: A Hybrid CNN-Transformer Model for Heart Disease Prediction Using Life History Data
items.title_zh: 基于生命历程数据的 CNN-Transformer 心脏病预测混合模型
items.summary: A study combines CNN and Transformer modules to predict heart disease from high-dimensional life history data, reporting better accuracy, precision and recall than SVM, CNN and LSTM benchmarks.

items.title: Learning from Noisy Labels with Contrastive Co-Transformer
items.title_zh: 使用对比协同 Transformer 从噪声标签中学习
items.summary: The paper introduces a Contrastive Co-Transformer framework for learning from noisy labels, combining contrastive and classification losses and reporting gains over state-of-the-art methods on six corrupted benchmark datasets including Clothing1M.

items.title: Provably Correct Automata Embeddings for Optimal Automata-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 面向最优自动机条件强化学习的可证明正确自动机嵌入
items.summary: The paper provides a theoretical framework showing automata-conditioned reinforcement learning is probably approximately correct learnable, and introduces a method that learns automata embeddings with correctness guarantees, yielding optimal multi-task policies.

items.title: Exploring the Performance Improvement of Tensor Processing Engines through Transformation in the Bit-weight Dimension of MACs
items.title_zh: 从 MAC 位权维度变换看张量处理引擎的性能提升
items.summary: The paper introduces a finer-grained notation for tensor processing engines centered on the bit-weight dimension of multiply-accumulators and four optimizations derived from it; an RTL design in SMIC 28nm reports area-efficiency gains of 1.27x to 1.56x and energy-efficiency gains of 1.04x to 1.56x across four classic architectures.

items.title: VideoPhy-2: A Challenging Action-Centric Physical Commonsense Evaluation in Video Generation
items.title_zh: VideoPhy-2：面向视频生成的物理常识评测基准
items.summary: VideoPhy-2 is an action-centric benchmark of 200 actions with human evaluation of semantic adherence, physical commonsense and grounding in physical rules. Even the best model reached only 22% joint performance on the hard subset, and models struggled with conservation laws such as mass and momentum.

items.title: Aerial Infrared Health Monitoring of Solar Photovoltaic Farms at Scale
items.title_zh: 大规模太阳能光伏电站的航空红外健康监测
items.summary: A framework uses high-resolution airborne thermal infrared imagery and machine learning to detect and localize defects across thousands of North American solar photovoltaic sites and estimate performance losses.

items.title: Validating LLM-as-a-Judge Systems under Rating Indeterminacy
items.title_zh: 在评分不确定性下验证 LLM-as-a-Judge 系统
items.summary: The authors introduce a framework for validating LLM-as-a-judge systems when rating criteria allow multiple valid interpretations, and show that forced-choice ratings can select judge systems performing up to 31% worse than those chosen with multi-label response-set ratings across 11 tasks and 9 commercial LLMs.
